surface_mechanism_description: Self-limiting growth behavior was observed at the deposition temperatures ranging from 150 to 350 oC, and the film thickness increased linearly with growth cycles. The surface morphology and crystallinity of HfS2 thin films were analyzed by various characterization techniques. The temperature range of self-limiting reaction behavior and the growth rate were determined.
evidence: The reaction formula is as follows: Hf[(C2H5)(CH3)N]4(g) + 2 H2S(g) = HfS2(s) + 4 (C2H5)(CH3)NH(g). The surface morphology and crystallinity of HfS2 thin films were analyzed by various characterization techniques. The temperature range of self-limiting reaction behavior and the growth rate were determined. The oxygen content on the surface is much higher than that on the inside, suggesting that oxidation of HfS2 easily occurred under ambient conditions. It was demonstrated that higher deposition temperature could enlarge grain size and improve HfS2 crystallinity, while causing crystallization of the mixed HfO2 above 450 oC.
